basic_details.job_title: VVGNLI Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The V. V. Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI), Sector 24, NOIDA, has invited applications for 2 Research Associate posts on the research project "Impact of various Government schemes in promoting sustainable agricultural livelihood". The duration is 6 months, the salary is Rs 27,356 excluding EPF and ESI, and the essential qualification is Post Graduation in Social Science. The last date of submission of application is 19 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice gives 19 November 2026 as the last date of submission of application. It does not describe the application format, the documents to attach or the mode of submission. The contact person is Dr. Shashi Bala, Senior Fellow, VVGNLI, email [email protected].
